 Germie Bernard Fantasy Football Start or Sit Advice for Week 10 
 NFL 
 start sit 
 DraftKings Fantasy Advice 
 Season Long 
 Published: 
 November 14, 2026 
 By: 
 DK Network AI 
 Germie Bernard has become a fixture in Pittsburgh’s passing game. With Roman Wilson and Michael Pittman Jr. both on injured reserve, he and DK Metcalf are leading the Steelers’ receiver room, and Bernard has drawn at least five targets in four straight games. Coming out of the bye, Pittsburgh visits Cincinnati in a division matchup that could turn into a shootout. Find out whether you should start or sit Germie Bernard in Week 10.
 Germie Bernard Start or Sit Advice for Week 10 
 His role is bigger than his season numbers show. Bernard holds 15.7% of Pittsburgh’s targets on the season, but since Week 5 he has drawn 31 of the team’s 124 targets, a 25.0% share. That stretch includes a 12-target, 11-catch, 25.7-point game against Tampa Bay. *]:mx-auto lg:[&>*]:mx-0"> 
 He is also a reliable target for Aaron Rodgers. Bernard has caught 32 of his 42 targets, a 76.2% catch rate, and 168 of his 284 receiving yards have come after the catch. He has also drawn seven red zone targets.
 Cincinnati’s offense could force the Steelers to keep throwing. The Bengals score 30.0 points per game and throw for 285.5 yards per game, well above the league averages of 23.0 and 218.9. Pittsburgh already averages 36.2 pass attempts per game, and a high-scoring game would push that even higher.
 The matchup itself is fair. Cincinnati allows 30.3 PPR points per game to wide receivers, right around the league average of 31.3, and 50.6 YAC per game, slightly above the league mark of 48.7. The Bengals have faced Tampa Bay, Houston, Pittsburgh, Jacksonville, Miami, Baltimore, Tennessee and Atlanta, a group throwing 6% above league average against them, so that is an honest read. Safety Kyle Dugger has also not practiced this week after missing the past two games.
 The Biggest Fantasy Risk for Germie Bernard in Week 10 
 His recent usage has been short and shallow. Bernard has caught eight passes for 57 yards over his last two games, and he has just 116 air yards on the season. That is only 15.4% of the team’s air yards, compared with Metcalf’s 35.8%, so he needs a lot of catches to produce.
 Pittsburgh’s passing game has not helped. The Steelers carry an 85.6 quarterback rating and average 94.0 air yards per game against a league average of 124.3, and they convert just 50.0% of their red zone trips.
 Cincinnati can also get after the quarterback. The Bengals have 23 sacks, above the league average of 20.0, which could cut into the time Rodgers has to find him.
 Fantasy Outlook for Germie Bernard in Week 10 
 Bernard is a Start in Week 10 as a FLEX play in PPR leagues. His target share has been steady since Wilson and Pittman went down, and a game against a high-scoring Cincinnati offense gives him a strong chance at more volume.
 His ceiling depends on catches more than big plays, so his value is lower in standard formats. Fantasy managers covering Eagles, Buccaneers, Bears and Broncos players on bye can plug him into a FLEX spot with confidence in his role, if not in Pittsburgh’s offense.
